# Filter logs within the failure time window and for the specified components

# Keywords related to possible root cause reasons (case insensitive)
keywords = [
    'CPU', 'memory', 'latency', 'packet loss', 'disk I/O', 'disk space',
    'JVM CPU', 'OOM', 'heap', 'error', 'warn', 'fail'
]

# Create a regex pattern for keyword search (case insensitive)
pattern = re.compile('|'.join([re.escape(k) for k in keywords]), re.IGNORECASE)

# Filter logs containing any of the keywords in the 'value' field
filtered_logs_keywords = filtered_logs_components[filtered_logs_components['value'].str.contains(pattern, na=False)]

# Count frequency of each keyword by component
def count_keywords(text):
    found = pattern.findall(text)
    return [k.lower() for k in found]

# Explode matched keywords for counting

# Group by component and keyword to get frequency

    exploded_keywords.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'matched_keywords'])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name='frequency')

)
